arxiv-2109-13228.title: PASS: An ImageNet replacement for self-supervised pretraining without humans
arxiv-2109-13228.creator: Yuki M. Asano, Christian Rupprecht, Andrew Zisserman, Andrea Vedaldi
arxiv-2109-13228.description: Abstract Computer vision has long relied on ImageNet and other large datasets of images sampled from the Internet for pretraining models. However, these datasets have ethical and technical shortcomings, such as containing personal information taken without consent, unclear license usage, biases, and, in some cases, even problematic image content.

arxiv-2208-06138.title: Stickelberger’s discriminant theorem for algebras
arxiv-2208-06138.creator: Asher Auel, Owen Biesel, John Voight
arxiv-2208-06138.description: Abstract . Stickelberger proved that the discriminant of a number field is congruent to 0 0 or 1 1 modulo 4 4 . We generalize this to an arbitrary (not necessarily commutative) ring of finite rank over ℤ \mathbb{Z} using techniques from linear algebra. Our proof relies on elementary matrix identities. 1.

arxiv-2209-08713.title: Non-uniqueness of Leray solutions to the hypodissipative Navier-Stokes equations in two dimensions
arxiv-2209-08713.creator: Dallas Albritton, Maria Colombo
arxiv-2209-08713.description: Abstract . We exhibit non-unique Leray solutions of the forced Navier-Stokes equations with hypodissipation in two dimensions. Unlike the solutions constructed in [ ABC22b ] , the solutions we construct live at a supercritical scaling, in which the hypodissipation formally becomes negligible as t → 0 + t\to 0^{+} .

arxiv-2306-06616.title: Largest exact structures and almost split sequences on hearts of twin cotorsion pairs Thanks: The authors would like to thank Professor Bin Zhu for helpful discussions.
arxiv-2306-06616.creator: Yu Liu, Wuzhong Yang and Panyue Zhou
arxiv-2306-06616.description: Abstract . Hearts of cotorsion pairs on extriangulated categories are abelian categories. On the other hand, hearts of twin cotorsion pairs are not always abelian. They were shown to be semi-abelian by Liu and Nakaoka. Moreover, Hassoun and Shah proved that they are quasi-abelian under certain conditions.

arxiv-2312-01337.title: Relative Rota-Baxter operators of weight 0 on groups, pre-groups, braces, the Yang-Baxter equation and T T -structures
arxiv-2312-01337.creator: Yunnan Li, Yunhe Sheng, Rong Tang
arxiv-2312-01337.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yunnan Li, Yunhe Sheng, Rong Tang. In this paper, we study relative Rota-Baxter operators of weight 0 0 on groups and give various examples. In particular, we propose different approaches to study Rota-Baxter operators of weight 0 0 on groups and Lie groups. We establish various explicit relations among relative Rota-Baxter operators of weight 0 0 on groups, pre-groups, braces, set-theoretic solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation and T T -structures.

arxiv-2404-02055.title: On Hamiltonian Structures of Partial Difference Equations
arxiv-2404-02055.creator: Zhonglun Cao
arxiv-2404-02055.description: Abstract We first introduce the notion of Hamiltonian structure for a partial difference equation. Then we construct some infinite quivers, and realize the discrete KdV equation, the Hirota-Miwa equation and its various reductions as the mutation relations of the corresponding cluster algebras.

arxiv-2408-14629.title: Scalar Gravitational Aharonov-Bohm Effect: Generalization of the Gravitational Redshift
arxiv-2408-14629.creator: Michael E. Tobar, Michael T. Hatzon, Graeme R. Flower, Maxim Goryachev
arxiv-2408-14629.description: Abstract The Aharonov-Bohm effect is a quantum mechanical phenomenon that demonstrates how potentials can have observable effects even when the classical fields associated with those potentials are absent. Initially proposed for electromagnetic interactions, this effect has been experimentally confirmed and extensively studied over the years.

arxiv-2504-09550.title: Spatially resolved polarization variation of the Crab Nebula
arxiv-2504-09550.creator: Chao Zuo, Fei Xie, Mingyu Ge, Wei Deng, Kuan Liu, Fabio La Monaca, Alessandro Di Marco, Wenhao Wei, Wei Chen
arxiv-2504-09550.description: Abstract We examined the spatially resolved polarization variations in the Crab Nebula over two years, using observational data from the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE), and offer key insights into its magnetic field structures and evolution. The results show significant temporal changes in the polarization degree (PD) across three regions of interest in the 2–8 keV energy band.

arxiv-2508-20230.title: Coresets from Trajectories: Selecting Data via Correlation of Loss Differences
arxiv-2508-20230.creator: Manish Nagaraj mnagara@purdue.edu, Deepak Ravikumar dravikum@purdue.edu, Kaushik Roy kaushik@purdue.edu
arxiv-2508-20230.description: Abstract Deep learning models achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains but face scalability challenges in real-time or resource-constrained scenarios. To address this, we propose Correlation of Loss Differences ( 𝙲𝙻𝙳 \mathtt{CLD} ), a simple and scalable metric for coreset selection that identifies the most impactful training samples by measuring their alignment with the loss trajectories of a held-out validation set.

arxiv-2511-20935.title: UruDendro4: A Benchmark Dataset for Automatic Tree-Ring Detection in Cross-Section Images of Pinus taeda L. Thanks: This work was funded by ANII under project number ANII-FMV-176061. 979-8-3315-9170-0/25/$31.00 ©2025 IEEE
arxiv-2511-20935.creator: Henry Marichal, Joaquín Blanco, Diego Passarella, Gregory Randall
arxiv-2511-20935.description: Abstract Tree-ring growth represents the annual wood increment for a tree, and quantifying it allows researchers to assess which silvicultural practices are best suited for each species. Manual measurement of this growth is time-consuming and often imprecise, as it is typically performed along 4 to 8 radial directions on a cross-sectional disc.

pmc-10646219.title: Arf1 Ablation in Colorectal Cancer Cells Activates a Super Signal Complex in DC to Enhance Anti‐Tumor Immunity
pmc-10646219.creator: Handong Ma, Wanqi Fang, Qiaoming Li, Yuetong Wang, Steven X. Hou
pmc-10646219.description: The anti‐tumor immune response relies on interactions among tumor cells and immune cells. However, the molecular mechanisms by which tumor cells regulate DCs as well as DCs regulate T cells remain enigmatic. Here, the authors identify a super signaling complex in DCs that mediates the Arf1‐ablation‐induced anti‐tumor immunity.

pmc-11463741.title: Genotype distribution and allele frequency of thioester-containing protein 1(Tep1) and its effect on development of Plasmodium oocyst in populations of Anopheles arabiensis in Ethiopia
pmc-11463741.creator: Arega Tsegaye, Assalif Demissew, Ashenafi Abossie, Hallelujah Getachew, Kassahun Habtamu, Teshome Degefa, Xiaoming Wang, Ming-Chieh Lee, Daibin Zhong, James W. Kazura, Guiyun Yan, Delenasaw Yewhalaw
pmc-11463741.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThioester-containing protein 1 (TEP1) is a crucial component of mosquitoes’ natural resistance to parasites. To effectively combat malaria, there is a need to better understand how TEP1 polymorphism affects phenotypic traits during infections.

pmc-11504396.title: Adaptation and Validation of the Intercultural Effectiveness Scale in a Sample of Initial Teacher Training Students in Chile
pmc-11504396.creator: Juan Carlos Beltrán-Véliz, José Luis Gálvez-Nieto, Maura Klenner-Loebel, Nathaly Vera-Gajardo, Claudia Quaiser-Pohl
pmc-11504396.description: Intercultural effectiveness is a relevant construct for improving the training of future teachers and promoting culturally diverse educational environments. This study aimed to adapt and validate the intercultural effectiveness scale (IES) in a sample of pre-service teachers in Chile. A cross-sectional design study was conducted, in which 584 Chilean university students participated (male = 37.8%; female = 61.

pmc-12388726.title: Enhancing Electron Transfer Efficiency in Microbial Fuel Cells Through Gold Nanoparticle Modification of Saccharomyces cerevisiae
pmc-12388726.creator: Teresė Kondrotaitė-Intė, Antanas Zinovičius, Domas Pirštelis, Inga Morkvėnaitė
pmc-12388726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study investigates microbial fuel cell (MFC) performance through the modification of Saccharomyces cerevisiae with gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) and polypyrrole (PPy). The yeast/AuNP-modified electrodes generated the highest median current of 2.57 nA, significantly outperforming the yeast/PPy-modified (0.82 nA) electrodes. Power density measurements further confirmed the superior performance of the yeast/AuNP-modified electrodes, showcasing a notable improvement in current densities and power outputs.

pmc-12389354.title: Human Tuberculosis in Migrant and Autocthonous Patients: A Ten-Year Single-Centre Experience
pmc-12389354.creator: Isabel García Soriano, Mónica Romero, Isabel Gascón, Verónica Solves, Reyes Pascual, Philip Erick Wikman-Jorgensen, Craig Kinnear
pmc-12389354.description: In recent years, migratory movements have increased. This study aimed to compare tuberculosis cases in migrant and autochthonous patients. We conducted a retrospective analytical cohort study of patients diagnosed with tuberculosis in the Elda Health District (Alicante, Spain) between 2013 and 2023. Of the 98 patients analyzed, 28 (29.6%) were migrants, predominantly male (65%), with a mean age of 35.

pmc-12781440.title: Genotoxicity assessment of mesoporous silica and graphene oxide in GDL1 cells
pmc-12781440.creator: Rikako Ishigamori, Akiko Ohno, Kiyoshi Fukuhara, Shinya Hasegawa, Yukari Totsuka
pmc-12781440.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundNanomaterials such as mesoporous silica and graphene oxide are increasingly used in industrial, medical, and cosmetic applications due to their unique physical and chemical properties. However, their potential genotoxicity remains poorly understood.

pmc-12820893.title: Unilateral Biportal Endoscopic Spine Surgery: Managing Complex and Revision Cases With a Minimally Invasive Approach
pmc-12820893.creator: Alhareth Maaya, Jin Hwa Eum
pmc-12820893.description: Revision spinal surgeries present challenges due to complications from previous surgeries, such as scar tissue and altered anatomy. Unilateral biportal endoscopic (UBE) spine surgery is a versatile, minimally invasive technique that can effectively address a wide range of spinal pathologies, including complex and revision cases.

pmc-13137961.title: HDAC1 Regulates Acquired Resistance to EGFR Inhibitors through the TFCP2-NDRG1 Signaling Axis in Pancreatic Cancer
pmc-13137961.creator: Taoyu Chen, Yuxuan Li, Yan Sun, Qixun Fu, Heshui Wu, Dan Li, Dianyun Ren
pmc-13137961.description: Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is a pivotal therapeutic target in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC); however, the clinical efficacy of tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) such as erlotinib is frequently curtailed by acquired resistance. This study identifies histone deacetylase 1 (HDAC1) as a critical epigenetic driver of this resistance.

pmc-13196308.title: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes Green Dialysis Controversies Conference: A Carbon Footprint and Sustainability Report
pmc-13196308.creator: Katherine A Barraclough, Kilian Osberghaus, Julian Hirschmann, Tanina Schlieker, Morgan E Grams, Michel Jadoul, Jennifer E Flythe
pmc-13196308.description: esources (materials, energy, and water), and generate significant waste. Although many of these impacts are local, their greenhouse gas burden is global. Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) is a global, nonprofit foundation that develops and implements evidence-based clinical practice guidelines in kidney disease.

pmc-13372803.title: Maternal genetic liability for neuroticism and breastfeeding intention, initiation and maintenance
pmc-13372803.creator: Elizabeth C Braithwaite, Amy Campbell, Holly Fraser, Nicky Wright, Jasmine Hearn, Jennifer McGahan, Lucy Bowes, Alex SF Kwong, Hannah Sallis, Rebecca M Pearson
pmc-13372803.description: BackgroundRelationships between maternal mental health and breastfeeding outcomes are complex, with evidence of bi-directional effects complicated by culturally specific residual confounding and selection bias.AimsThis study aimed to examine, for the first time, associations between maternal genetic liability for neuroticism and breastfeeding intention, initiation and maintenance.MethodWe used data from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) prospective birth cohort.

pmc-13580116.title: Fragment-Based Discovery of KLK6 and KLK7 Inhibitors
pmc-13580116.creator: Renato Ferreira de Freitas, Feryel Soualmia, Rilès Boumali, Yasmine Harrak, Chahrazade El Amri
pmc-13580116.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Human tissue kallikreins are serine proteases implicated in the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative diseases, skin disorders, and various cancers. Despite their therapeutic relevance, the development of selective small-molecule inhibitors for these enzymes has been limited compared to other serine proteases. To address this, we implemented a fragment-based virtual screening (FBVS) strategy to identify chemically tractable starting points for the inhibition of KLK6 and KLK7.

pmc-13624465.title: Real world lessons on tyrosine kinase inhibitor response and resistance in CML from a developing country Pakistan
pmc-13624465.creator: Sahrish Khan, Zafar Iqbal, Muhammad Usman Ghani, Muhammad Farooq Sabar
pmc-13624465.description: Objectives:This study aimed to evaluate treatment responses, resistance and molecular characteristics of CML patients on TKI therapies to identify factors associated with suboptimal outcomes.Methodology:A retrospective observational study was conducted between January 2022 to December 2025 on 209 CML patients recruited at Mayo Hospital Lahore. Patients who achieved DMR and MMR were included. Minimum required duration of DMR was three years.

pmc-13677061.title: Artificial intelligence in spatial transcriptomics: a review of methods, datasets, and directions
pmc-13677061.creator: Neelam Sharma, Rabia Şen, Cemal Erdem
pmc-13677061.description: Spatial transcriptomics (STs) measures gene expression while retaining the location of transcripts or cells within tissue sections. Unlike bulk RNA sequencing, which averages expression across cell populations, and single-cell RNA sequencing, which generally requires tissue dissociation, ST links molecular profiles to tissue architecture. This spatial information supports the analysis of tissue heterogeneity, cellular organization, and potential intercellular interactions.

pmc-7618959.title: Amyloid fibril polymorphism: Structural mechanisms of assembly and the links to disease
pmc-7618959.creator: Alexander I. P. Taylor, Sheena E. Radford
pmc-7618959.description: Amyloid fibrils are involved in devastating conditions such as Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, Huntington’s disease, and systemic amyloidosis. They exhibit polymorphism, meaning that a single protein sequence can adopt different amyloid folds that vary with time and self-assembly conditions. Polymorphism confounds structure-based drug design and raises fundamental questions regarding why particular fibril structures form and how they cause disease.
